title: Indexed sign product modulo two
statement: For any index type, any finite set $S$ of indices, and any assignment of signs to those indices, the integer product of the signs over $S$, reduced modulo $2$, equals $1$ in the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of indices
